answer: Lantern Gap Enforcement: each agent identity must idle 90 s between accepted actions or the registry drops the burst. A sybil running N parallel identities burns N × 90 s of wall-clock per voyage, so total throughput is capped at one action per 90 s per slot. The crystal checkpoint at the next block verifies the gap; a missed gap voids the fee and stalls that identity for a full cycle.
